name: Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta
unique: Five hundred balloons launch at dawn from a single field, with the Dawn Patrol lighting up like lanterns and a sky that turns into a moving mosaic.
buzz: The 5am alarm is nonnegotiable and worth it; dress in layers and take the park-and-ride. The evening glow is a different show.

name: Chaco Culture
customer: History buffs, photographers, dark sky people
unique: A thousand year old ceremonial city of monumental masonry, aligned to the sun and moon, with roads and signal stations across a hundred miles of desert.
buzz: People call it the American Machu Picchu; the dirt road in is rough and the silence is the point. Stay for the night sky program.

name: White Sands
unique: 275 square miles of gypsum dunes as white as snow, where you can sled down in January and watch the sunset turn them pink and blue.
buzz: Bring a plastic sled and wax; the dunes are otherworldly at golden hour. The missile range occasionally closes the road.

name: Carlsbad Caverns
unique: A 750-foot descent into a limestone chamber the size of a cathedral, with a natural entrance that swallows you and a bat flight out at dusk in summer.
buzz: The self guided Big Room walk is stunning and the ranger tours go deeper; the elevator is unreliable, so be ready to walk.

name: Meow Wolf Santa Fe
unique: The original House of Eternal Return: a Victorian house that opens into a multidimensional narrative maze inside a former bowling alley, built with Game of Thrones money.
buzz: The original is still the best of the Meow Wolf locations; the story is denser and the sense of discovery stronger. Book ahead.

name: Bosque del Apache Crane Festival
unique: Tens of thousands of sandhill cranes and snow geese lift off the Rio Grande wetlands at dawn in a wall of wings and noise, with the Chupadera Mesa behind.
buzz: Dawn at the flight deck is the classic; photographers line up before light. Book the festival workshops early.

name: Taos Pueblo
unique: A thousand year old adobe pueblo still lived in without electricity or running water, with a mission church, hornos and artisans selling from their doors.
buzz: The tour is worth taking and the rules matter, ask before photographing anyone. It is a home, not a set.

name: Sandia Peak Tramway
unique: The longest aerial tram in the Americas: 2.7 miles up a sandstone cliff to a 10,378-foot summit with a restaurant and trails in the spruce forest.
buzz: The ride is smooth and the view is enormous; sunset is the best slot. The restaurant is convenient, not a destination.

name: Tinkertown Museum
unique: A maze of rooms built from bottles and cement, filled with thousands of carved wooden figures and animated miniature scenes, on the road up to Sandia Crest.
buzz: People describe it as a fever dream in the best way; the mechanical scenes are charming. Small and unforgettable.

name: Roswell UFO Museum
company: International UFO Museum and Research Center
unique: A former movie theater filled with affidavits, newspaper clippings, dioramas and a very serious research library about the 1947 crash that the government says was a weather balloon.
buzz: It is cheesy and sincere and the gift shop is excellent; the alien-themed town is half the fun.
